definitions.gloss: transparency; clarity; translucence; a sense of clearness
definitions.explanation: A quality of being clear, pure, or see-through. Widely used to describe skin, voices, music, colors, and atmospheres that give a clean, pure impression. Very common in beauty, fashion, and artistic contexts.

examples.japanese: {透明感|とうめいかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧。
examples.english: Skin with a clear, luminous quality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歌声|うたごえ}→歌声：20116_utagoe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{透明感|とうめいかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Her singing voice has a pure, crystalline quality.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{化粧水|けしょうすい}→化粧水：15802_keshousui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{透明感|とうめいかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{評判|ひょうばん}→評判：03586_hyouban⟧だ。
examples.english: This toner is said to give your skin a clear, radiant glow.

notes:
{透明感|とうめいかん} describes a quality of purity, clarity, or luminousness. Formed from ⟦{透明|とうめい}→透明：04565_toumei⟧ (transparent) + ⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ (sense/feeling).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {透明感|とうめいかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧: clear, luminous skin
- {透明感|とうめいかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧: a pure, crystalline voice
- {透明感|とうめいかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧: a clear, clean color
- {透明感|とうめいかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to achieve a sense of clarity

USAGE:
Very common in beauty and cosmetics advertising. Also used for voices, music, and visual aesthetics to convey a clean, ethereal impression. Always positive.

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{透明性|とうめいせい}→透明性：05576_toumeisei⟧ is used for organizational or political transparency (accountability, openness). {透明感|とうめいかん} is aesthetic and sensory — they are not interchangeable.
